scripts.format: bunx --bun --no-install oxfmt cli.ts modules scripts herdr tools/oxlint dependency-cruiser.config.cjs package.json operator-gate.json tsconfig.json .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json .github
scripts.format:check: bunx --bun --no-install oxfmt --check cli.ts modules scripts herdr tools/oxlint dependency-cruiser.config.cjs package.json operator-gate.json tsconfig.json .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json .github
scripts.lint: bunx --bun --no-install oxlint --deny-warnings cli.ts modules scripts herdr tools/oxlint dependency-cruiser.config.cjs
scripts.lint:modules: bun scripts/check-module-shape.ts && bunx --bun --no-install depcruise --config dependency-cruiser.config.cjs cli.ts modules scripts
scripts.quality:static: bun run --parallel format:check lint typecheck lint:modules lint:skills test:module-boundaries
